listing.name: Lauren Cinematic Dogfights AI v1.0
listing.summary: Cinematic dogfights between fighters and interceptors. Bombers focused on the bombing run. Interceptors intercept. Requires lazylib.
listing.aiSummary: Creates cinematic dogfights where fighters and interceptors engage in combat while bombers focus on bombing runs.

description: Creates cinematic dogfights where fighters and interceptors engage in combat while bombers focus on bombing runs. Interceptors are tasked with intercepting enemy craft.
